bio: A yellow kit with a play-button patch on its chest. It copies any dance it sees, adds a sound, and shows it back to you before you have finished the first one.
A ferret with a clock-face patch on its chest that dances in fifteen-second loops and knows exactly what you want to see next. Look away and it has already found the next one.
note: Every loop is a little different, on purpose.
